title: Harnessing Medical Visual-Language Models with Agentic Evidence Management
abstract: arXiv:2611.25840v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical vision-language agents increasingly rely on segmentation tools, and recent work has focused on acquiring the right mask, often treating a good mask as the end point of tool use. But do these agents use the resulting evidence effectively? To answer this question, we need a benchmark that separates evidence use from segmentation quality, spans multiple medical image types, and allows the same mask to be presented in different ways. Existing medical VQA datasets do not jointly provide these properties. We therefore construct Mask-Evidence MedVQA, a 2.5K-example benchmark spanning four image types, where each question is paired with an answer-relevant ground-truth mask and multiple possible renderings. Our study reveals two limitations of direct tool use. First, evidence presentation matters. Different renderings of the same fixed mask can substantially change model behavior. Second, masks introduce an evidence trade-off. Highlight

translated_title: 利用智能体式证据管理充分发挥医学视觉-语言模型的能力
translated_abstract: 医学视觉-语言智能体日益依赖分割工具，近期的研究主要集中于获取正确的掩码（mask），往往将一个良好的掩码视为工具使用的终点。但这些智能体是否有效地利用了由此产生的证据？为了回答这个问题，我们需要一个能够将证据使用与分割质量相分离、覆盖多种医学图像类型、并允许以不同方式呈现同一掩码的基准。现有的医学VQA数据集无法同时满足这些特性。因此，我们构建了Mask-Evidence MedVQA，一个包含2.5K样本、覆盖四种图像类型的基准，其中每个问题都配有与答案相关的真实掩码以及多种可能的渲染方式。我们的研究揭示了直接使用工具的两个局限性：其一，证据的呈现方式至关重要，同一固定掩码的不同渲染方式会显著改变模型行为；其二，掩码引入了证据权衡问题……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究构建了Mask-Evidence MedVQA基准（含2.5K样本、覆盖四种图像类型），发现医学视觉-语言智能体对分割掩码的呈现方式高度敏感且掩码证据存在权衡问题，并据此提出智能体式证据管理方法以提升模型对分割证据的有效利用。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Mask-Evidence MedVQA, a benchmark showing that medical vision-language agents are highly sensitive to how segmentation masks are rendered and face an evidence trade-off, and proposes agentic evidence management to improve the effective use of segmentation evidence.
